name: quegly
description: Schedule, publish and measure social media posts from your AI agent with Quegly: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Threads, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Pinterest and Telegram, from one post to every channel, plus post analytics.

api_key.label: Quegly API key
api_key.description: Create one at quegly.com/settings/api. It starts with qgl_ and needs an active Quegly subscription.
